description: This file defines the interface for a Zigbee diagnostics cluster, including callback functions, creation function, and methods to get last message RSSI and LQI data.

methods.name: diagnosticsClusterCreate
methods.description: Creates a diagnostics cluster instance with specified callbacks and context.

methods.name: diagnosticsClusterGetLastMessageLqi
methods.description: Retrieves the last message's LQI for a given device identified by EUI64 and endpoint.

methods.name: diagnosticsClusterGetLastMessageRssi
methods.description: Retrieves the last message's RSSI for a given device identified by EUI64 and endpoint.
